run_adsorption_energy_analysis: run the energy.py script to parse MOF adsorption energy data and generate parity plots
parse_adsorption_energy_data: parse the adsorption_energy.txt file to extract MOF names, defect concentrations, and adsorption energies
filter_promising_mofs: filter pristine and defective MOFs where CO2 adsorption energy is less than H2O adsorption energy
compute_lowest_adsorption_energies: compute the lowest adsorption energy per MOF for CO2, H2O, and co-adsorption configurations
generate_parity_plot: generate a scatter plot comparing CO2 vs H2O adsorption energies for pristine and defective MOFs
